fixes.description: The user story requires face search against 'approved tenant populations,' but FaceSearchService.IndexAsync accepted an arbitrary caller-supplied raw BiometricSample, extracted a template directly through IFaceProvider, and indexed it into the searchable gallery with no check of capture quality, liveness, or BIO-BIO-003 approval status. An acceptance probe (approved_population_probe.py) showed this let an unapproved or failed-liveness capture, or outright arbitrary bytes, enter the exact population every search result and audit event labelled 'tenant_gallery' as though it were approved.
fixes.fix: IndexAsync no longer takes a BiometricSample parameter at all. It resolves the claimed identity's current approved reference through the new Domain/IFaceGalleryApprovalGateway.cs (real adapter in BioBio007Module wraps BIO-BIO-003's already-registered FaceEnrolmentService.GetLatestReferenceAsync, mirroring BIO-BIO-005's own IFaceReferenceGateway shape) and indexes that reference's own already-vetted BiometricTemplate. BIO-BIO-003's own FaceEnrolmentService.CaptureAsync only ever constructs a FaceBiometricReference for a capture that passed both its seven-check quality gate and its liveness gate, so a non-null gateway result is sufficient proof of approval. A person with no approved reference throws FaceSearchException.NoApprovedReference rather than falling back to raw indexing. FaceSearchService is now registered Scoped (was Singleton) since it depends on the Scoped FaceEnrolmentService via the gateway.

summary: Implements BIO-BIO-007 (1:N face identification/duplicate search against an APPROVED tenant population), built directly on BIO-BIO-001's provider-neutral biometric contracts (IFaceProvider/IBiometricMatcher/BiometricTemplate). AC01: FaceSearchService.SearchAsync compares a live probe against every OTHER identity in this feature's own IFaceGalleryStore, returns FaceSearchCandidate entries ordered by score descending and capped at maxCandidates; after the round-2 fix, the gallery itself only ever contains BIO-BIO-003-approved references, resolved via Domain/IFaceGalleryApprovalGateway.cs - IndexAsync takes no raw sample and cannot be used to inject an unapproved capture. AC02: a TENANT-WIDE feature flag (IFaceSearchFeatureFlagPolicy.IsEnabledForTenant), fail-closed by default, is checked before the gallery is even read. AC03: FaceSearchResult/FaceSearchCandidate carry no allow/deny or authorization field of any kind, and FaceSearchService exposes no decide/authorize method whatsoever - a stronger separation than BIO-BIO-005's own evidence/decision split. AC04: this project has zero ProjectReference to BIO-IDN-001 anywhere, so it structurally cannot call PersonService to merge/archive/delete anything; this story defines no duplicate-review queue of its own since none of its five ACs ask for one. AC05: IFaceGalleryStore is tenant-keyed with cross-tenant lookups returning empty; FaceSearchResult.PopulationScope/PopulationSize name exactly what was searched on every result; every search writes a durability-checked Audit/FaceSearchAuditEvent via IFaceSearchAuditSink, applying the same ADR-0003 Decision 7 discipline every mutating service in this codebase uses. Gallery store/audit sink/service are all internal or Scoped as appropriate, gated by an explicit InternalsVisibleTo seam.
